title: Keep Your Rate
music: synthesized toy-pop score that stops dead twice and swells to brass for the scale reveal
topic: Refinance vs HELOC or second mortgage when you hold a 3-4% mortgage and need $100K cash
hook: Got a 3-4% mortgage and need cash? Don't refinance the whole thing. Not yet.
logline: A homeowner with a gold tower of five $100K bricks at 3-4% needs one more brick and nearly lets a REFINANCE wrecking ball knock the whole tower down to get it.
structure: One tower's near-miss. Setup 0-14s (hook, tower = $500K at 3-4%, need = one red $100K brick), turn 14-25s (wrecking ball swings, silence, collapse, prepayment penalty, then the film rewinds it), resolution 25-44s (red brick of HELOC or second mortgage snaps on top, caveats, see-saw: sometimes refinancing still wins), payoff 44-55s (crane to the kitchen-table calculator: run the numbers). Ends on the ball swinging in again = frame 1.
device: gold tower of five $100K bricks, a brick wrecking ball labelled REFINANCE, a real rigid-body collapse then stop-motion rewind, one red brick snapped on top; camera on ones, bricks and character on twos
rejectedStyles: data-physical (needs a published statistic with source line)
bauhaus-shapes (explains the ratio, not the temptation)
rejectedStructures: countdown of mistakes: a list with no through-line or turn
before/after split: two half-width towers, answer shown before the question
lessons: PLAYBOOK 'How the first three reels measure up': it ends on a generic 'Message me' end card; cut it and loop instead.
